risks.risk: Page count may be higher than claimed, affecting wear and likely service/consumables cost.
risks.proof: A clear photo/screenshot of the machine’s internal counters (total prints and colour prints) from the menu.
risks.if_unproven: Price as higher-wear used unit (worst case: not low page count).

risks.risk: Consumables may not be genuinely new (or may be near end-of-life), affecting print quality and replacement cost.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of installed toner and drum labels/part numbers (and any replacement date/sticker).
risks.if_unproven: Price as consumables unknown/possibly worn (worst case: needs replacement soon).

risks.risk: Intermittent paper path issues may exist even if it worked once.
risks.proof: Video/clip of a multi-page print run (e.g., 20–50 pages) showing no jam/error on the screen.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potential paper-jam/maintenance risk (worst case: not reliably jam-free).

risks.risk: Missing accessories/options or incomplete configuration may limit functionality.
risks.proof: Photos of all included trays/attachments and a menu screen showing installed options (finisher/scan/network).
risks.if_unproven: Price as base unit with unknown options (worst case: limited functionality).

risks.risk: Condition/transport damage may not show externally (rollers/fuser/sensors).
risks.proof: Print-quality sample (colour test page) and any accessible maintenance/error history.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown condition (worst case: may require servicing).

proof_requests: Counter proof: photo/screenshot of total page count (and colour page count if separate).
Consumables proof: close-up photos of toner/drum labels/part numbers and any replacement sticker/date.
Jam-free proof: short video of a multi-page print run with no error messages.
Accessories/options proof: photos of included trays/attachments and a menu screen showing installed options.
Print-quality proof: colour test page showing no banding/colour faults.
response.reason: The seller’s claim of testing is not supported by any new verifiable evidence. Without counter/consumables/jam-test proof, the key factors that determine price remain unconfirmed, so pricing would be guesswork.
